definitions: To be forced to retract a statement or admission, especially one made boastfully or confidently, and to admit that one was wrong.
To acknowledge that something one said earlier was incorrect or foolish.
examples: After boasting about his team's victory, he had to eat his words when they lost the championship.
I had to eat my words after I said she couldn't do it, and she proved me wrong.
He'll have to eat his words when the truth comes out.
